rationale: David and Joseph both bring hands-on experience shipping robotics in real-world domains — David as CTO/Head of R&D at autonomous drone and tractor companies, Joseph through his work at Nupeak Robotics on autonomous fruit-picking. intro_message: David Chen, meet Joseph Zheng — you both have shipping experience in agricultural and autonomous robotics, and David's expertise in production-ready real-time infrastructure for robots could be valuable context as you work on physical AI projects.
